verdict.rationale: WorkOS explicitly documents M2M applications for client-credentials-style machine authentication, describing them as used to provide programmatic API access credentials to customers/partners without human involvement (workos-docs-32), alongside supporting RBAC/session JWT enforcement infrastructure. missing for 10: no explicit mention of the OAuth 'client_credentials' grant name or token endpoint details, and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the M2M flow working in practice.
